newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends up after rangebound trade.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends up after rangebound trade.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES -The market closed higher after drifted narrowly throughout with keen participation remaining absent. The rise reflected soyoil gains in Chicago and a bullish March 1-20 export data by SGS. Trading was volatile and June futures resistance is 1,260 and support at 1,240.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Interest was seen among nearby CPOs and palm olein. The market awaited the outcome from Chicago soyoil.
"We also have to see the performance of the Chicago soyoil futures market," another trader added.
Trading was fairly volatile and turnover was 1,885 lots.
Among physicals, March (south) crude palm ol was offered at 1,287.50 ringgit against bids of 1,285 after trading at 1,285 and 1,287.50.
March (central) saw offers at 1,277.50 against bids of 1,270 and March (north) at 1,267.50 against 1,260.
Apr (south) was offered at 1,287.50 with bids at 1,285 with early transactions from 1,285 and 1,287.50 and Apr (central) at 1,277.50 against 1,270.
Among refined products, Apr RBD palm oil was offered at $547.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, May $540, June at $540 and July/Aug/Sept at $532.50.
Apr RBD palm olein saw offers at $580, May at $575, Jun at $570 and July/Aug/Sept at 565. Apr was traded $577.50 and $579.
Apr RBD palm stearin was offered at $440 and Apr/May palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $305.
